youtube.title: Which country has the most pyramids? It's not Egypt 🏜️
youtube.description:
Egypt, Mexico or the third one? The country everyone pictures when they hear 'pyramid' is not the one with the most of them. Another nation on the same river has nearly twice as many, steeper and smaller, and its kings once ruled Egypt itself as pharaohs.
Guess before the map lights up, then see the count, the royal site, and the long river journey between the two.
Which did you pick?
